sources.exactSource:
Ordinary safe assertion failures may continue ONLY after both integrity and known reap. Provenance, source/runtime admission, loader, membership/mode/hash or unknown-reap failure MUST stop admissions. Aggregate failure is sticky. Parent raw process files and in-child command captures precede assertions; scoped reason identity remains unchanged.

Process peak remains four: supervisor, coordinator, one outer and one nested owned tool. Worker streams share16MiB; compiler streams share8MiB; raw plus metadata share32MiB/job. IPC262144bytes/2048messages and phase4096events/4MiB remain unchanged. The fixed logical disk reservation is23.25GiB within24GiB; complete retained work is counted. No hard RSS, physical filesystem quota, escaped-descendant or opaque-host preemption guarantee is made. The inherited2MiB command capture is NOT the product16MiB cap. Overflow retains its bounded prefix and is a harness limitation, not public-boundary proof or automatically a product bug.

staticTrace: Supervisor initializes rawBudget.remaining =33554432 -request artifact bytes -4194304 reserved phase bytes.
Owned stdout/stderr decrement that shared balance; worker writeBytes/writeJson use EVIDENCE_RESERVE. Build adoption also explicitly charges its record.

Owned-process publishes each tool/outer .process.json with atomicJson without charging or reserving its bytes. Supervisor also publishes job-receipt.json, integrity-failure.json when needed and outer-outcome.json without charging the remaining job budget.
The closing job snapshot uses evidenceLimits.treeBytes268435456, not33554432; cohort disk accounting tests24GiB, not this per-job cap. There is no final combined32MiB check for these uncharged files.

Do not silently raise the32MiB cap, waive captured errors or merely relabel the reservation. No foreign patch by reviewer.
